entries.title: Alpha only: see the findings behind an answer
entries.body: In alpha builds, an answer that relies on what the crew learned shows each finding it used as a small link, with a dot that says whether the finding was checked or needs another look. Open one to read its evidence in the Knowledge browser. A task's record now lists the findings its work relied on, and opens the exact revision it used beside the current one. Ask about this, in the browser, starts a question for Firstmate in the message box for you to finish; nothing is sent until you send it. Stable releases do not have it.

picture.alt: An answer card listing the two findings it relies on, each as a small link led by a dot: one checked, one with differing evidence
